notes.title: New update out now!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow citizens!

We're excited to announce that a new update has landed in Century City, and it features a few improvements designed to enhance your gaming experience. Let's dive into what's new:

🛑 Pause & Play: Your in-game menu now doubles as a pause button in single-player mode. Need a quick break during intense matches? Just open the menu, and the world freezes in time, waiting for your triumphant return.

🔧 Loading Screen Liberation: We've squashed that pesky bug that trapped you in the loading screen limbo. Now, you'll glide smoothly into the main menu, ready for action.

📚 Bestiary Achievement Unlocked: We've updated the requirements for the bestiary achievement in single-player mode. You no longer need to have a Miss Rosebud to complete your Catalog of Junk and claim your well-deserved achievement.

But wait, there's more! We've also fine-tuned a few other aspects:


 Single-player difficulty will now reset correctly with your profile.
 The elevator in the tutorial match has learned to behave, no more replaying its descent.
 Reshuffling your controls? We've ironed out the kinks in rebinding gamepad inputs, even without a controller connected.


We're constantly working to make your journey in our game smoother and more enjoyable. As always, your feedback is our guiding star.

notes.title: SINGLE PLAYER UPDATE: PATCH NOTES & SALE
notes.notes:
Greetings Citizens!

Have you ever dreamed of wandering in Century City without The Others trying to kill you? Well, now you can!

We are happy to announce that we have added a brand-new Single Player Mode!
You can now play the classic hardcore top-down action experience offered by Hell is Others without facing other players in your same game.

To celebrate, Hell is Others will be 50% off from NOW until April 13th, 2023!

And without further ado, here are the Single Player Update Patch Notes! In addition, here are some juicy news about rebalancing, Easter, and more!

Singleplayer

 Dedicated loot distribution
 Dedicated waves configurations
 Dedicated Credit progression
 Toxicity and satiety bar modifies according to credit level

Rebalance

 Device Wheel: devices can be selected with a separate wheel from the weapons wheel. They still need to be intentionally selected before they can be used. It is a system to make it faster and more convenient to use otherwise ignored devices. This has been done to make the combat more exciting and add value to the devices!
 We rebalanced loot for Things level II to incentivize the player to go up in credit to fight against them;
 We rebalanced the Elimination Quests in order to make them less frustrating;
 Deodorant is now a Tranquilizer. On Others, while the item effect is applied, the player's Walking and Running "Movement type modifier" become the same as the Sneaking One;
 On Other Things, while the Deodorant effect is applied, the Item reduces the following Other Thing acoustic ranges: now it's way more difficult for the Thing to find you;
 We reworked the basement system: in this way, we try to enable the basement to have a maximum of storage slots for furniture and give the player the means to delete undesired ones;

Easter Update

 We added some funny Easter presents around the City: you can eat our sweet, funny eggs and gain some health!
 There's also some loot waiting for you in these Easter baskets: the more you grab, the more you get!
 Finally, a big, juicy present awaits you in your condo: have a lovely weekend, Citizens!

Bug fixing

 Fixed bonsai remaining watered if it was put in the basement before going to sleep;
 Others are no longer required to complete the bestiary achievement;
 Fixed the possibility of placing the bonsai inside the basement if watered;

We can't wait to read your opinions on the new update on our official Discord!

See you in Century City.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/964440?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=news&utm_medium=SinglePlayerUpdate

notes.title: HotFix: blue circle
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!

Today’s announcement will be very short, but we hope equally effective: we have fixed a problem with the blue circle. It was originally designed to highlight your party member, but instead, it appeared under some Other enemies in solo! 
Now you can go back to your brutal outings alone!

Until next time, Citizens!

notes.title: HotFix: keybindings
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens! 

Today we have a short but important announcement for you: we have fixed the problem of keybindings! 
From now on you can once again change the settings of the keys to your liking!

We are working on other fixes (for example, the blue circle of the duo that also appears for solo players), but they will take a little more time. We decided to publish this little hotfix, but more updates are coming.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
See you in the City, Citizens!

notes.title: HotFix 1.5.16
Patch Notes 1.4.8
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!

Today we update you on some recent fixes we’ve been working on, which should improve your quality of life and make your experience more fluid! Let's dive in.


 We are aware that some people still get stuck in the 'Connection in Progress' step. We care a lot about this problem. For this reason, we added some additional checks and logs in order to collect more information in case of such an event. If the problem persists, send us a message on the Hell Is Others' Discord! 

 We solved a problem that caused a series of chain accidents! In short, a certain way of saving data created stumbling blocks, but from now on: 


 You'll not be stuck in the "tutorial loop";
  Your hub changes remain even if you close the game immediately after;
  The game will save the action you perform even in case of a sudden game closure. That also applies to the objects you consume: fungi, pills, food, etc.;


 We also solved the bestiary navigation problem: now you can scroll up and down with W/S or arrows at the ends of the list.

 We also made pickaxes visible again in the UI, which did not appear to some users when they accessed the basement without going through the editor. 

 Now you can place doors without risking being soft-locked until restart.

 Now, leaving perishable food in the city store doesn’t trigger the "fridge" dialogue when Adam goes to sleep.

 We fixed a small sound bug: now, running is the noisiest movement, and sneaking around is the least noisy.

 There was a little problem with the Chateau Area, as some gold items also appeared outside Chateau Constant: now you have to explore the mansion again to get them.

 We fixed the Neon Open Sign: from now on, it doesn't highlight when we place the mouse pointer on it.

 We fixed the problem of the "No Exit" mission, which some players found duplicated.


Don't forget to join our Discord server to stay updated about the latest news.
Until next time, Citizens!

notes.title: HotFix 1.4.5

Hello citizens!

With this hotfix, we fixed some bugs and introduced QOL improvements.

Also, We are aware of a problem causing players to be stuck in the "connection in progress" after log-in.
You can try to fix it by verifying the game files on the Epic Games library!


- Fixed bug preventing the player from completing the tutorial after handing over the golden object to Octave.
- Fixed the primary interaction of ON lights after getting placed inside the hub, making the player interact with them twice in order to shut them off.
- Fixed bot spawns that caused some performance losses under certain circumstances.
- Improved the pocket user experience.
- Fixed bug preventing the Catalogue of Junk from updating if the object was placed in the pocket

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.4
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!

With these new patch notes, we have made several new improvements to features as well as fixed some of the bugs found in the previous update. 

We would like to highlight two features that have been patiently awaited and requested by you, our community, that have now arrived! 

The first one is that attributes will no longer reset anymore after sleeping. Secondly, we have now split solos and duo queues, in order to ensure a fairer matchmaking.

Read more for the full list of updates:

Melee animation swoosh
- Improved the animations for the melee weapon attacks.

Satiety and Food Clash
- Food only influences the Satiety bar. Fungi and Pills raise a new bar, called the Toxicity one.
- Satiety bar is reset after dying or going to sleep.
- Toxicity bar is reset only after dying.
- The Movement Speed attribute has been removed. In its place, the new Search attribute has been introduced: it changes the search speed of containers.
- Reduced the caps for Vitality and Endurance to +30%.
- Rebalanced fungi and pills consequently.

Improvements
- Improved the hub editing. Now furniture can be swapped and removed as pleased. There is only one constraint: in order to close the editor, there must be at least one piece of furniture belonging to the essential ones (bed, blood washer, telephone, door).
- We removed the ability to see the Credit Score from the life bar and in the match recap screen.
- We updated the Bestiary, adding all the new bots, screenshots, descriptions and loot. 
- Update the Credit quest and the Estate quests, in order to simplify the progression within the story for the player.

Balancing 
- Changed magazine size for MrChapman+ from 6 to 5.
- Changed magazine size for MrChapman++ from 8 to 6.
- Changed magazine size for MrWatts+ from 8 to 7.
- Changed magazine size for MrWatts++ from 10 to 8.

Bug Fix
- Fixed some pieces of furniture having the wrong icon inside the basement.
- Fixed some chairs/armchairs having the wrong sleep animation.
- Fixed some lights defaulting to the OFF status.
- Fixing katana and baseball bat not inflicting bleeding and stunning statuses respectively.
- Fixed particle smoke explosion.
- Fixed a bug that prevents the progression of elimination quests with "Any weapon" requirements if the player killed a Thing or an Other with bleeding or burning statuses.
- Added audio feedback when the player gets a reward after completing an Octave quest.
- Fixed a bug that made the health bar of Others and Things visible outside the Field Of View with burning and bleeding statues or if inside or behind the smoke.
- Fixed a bug that allowed to bind the ESC key when rebinding a key, blocking the player under certain circumstances.
- Fixed a bug preventing the player to extract after reconnecting to a game because lifts were not available before the timer ended.
- Fixed a bug where the journal and map UI panels were closed after getting damage from bleeding or burning statuses.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.35: Match reconnection is here!
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!

Here's a quick but really, really felt update from the development team!

We know that match reconnection was one of the most awaited features from the community, and, as we told you in our devlog, it was also one of our main focus during past and recent development. 

That's why we are really happy to tell you that  the match reconnection system is now live!

From now on, you'll be able to reconnect to matches after a disconnection!
Here's how it's gonna work:

 If you disconnect from the match, you'll be able to rejoin;
 If the match is over before you reconnect, it will count as a death;
 You can choose not to reconnect, but you'll lose all stats and loot, just like like when you die in the game;


We're really looking forward to seeing this feature improve your matches!

If you want to help us further, here you can find a survey on your experience with Hell is Others that could help us a lot: https://forms.gle/PtpGh7UDmhaoDNm26

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.25
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens! 
Here’s all you need to know about our new update! 
 
With this update we want to significantly improve your game experience, all while staying true to what Hell is Others is. Our focus for this update is a meta shift that allows new players to be more of a menace to more experienced players, ‘cause the concept at the core of Hell is Others is that... well, others can be our hell. 
 
Combining your feedback with our view, we decided to promote a more skill-based experience, where stockpiling Enhancers and good bullets alone is not enough to win most of the battles that you face.  

That’s why we tuned pills and fungi: the gap between new entries and veterans in the game was too big. Also, entering a match just to grind mushrooms to be competitive was not fun. Additionally, the old system allowed to improve all the Attributes without having to opt for specific builds, resulting in less interesting decisions to make and less variety in the encounters.
 
We came up with some solutions that we think you’ll appreciate:

 first, all Attributes now reset once you go to bed;
 secondly, satiety provided by pills and fungi means there’s a tighter limit to the stack-up of the enhancements: you have to choose a path, a build;

We also listened to your feedback about deodorants: you were right, their effect lasted too long. Now it only lasts for 60 seconds, so you will have to make strategic choices and choose if you want to use it in an offensive or a defensive way. 

You can find the detailed patch note below!


 Attributes now reset when going to sleep

We also decided to give Miss Rosebud, Adam’s base gun, a movement speed bonus. We noticed that new players tend to run around with the base pistol a lot, so now, should they need to escape, it is easier for them not to fall prey to more experienced players with more Stamina or Movement Speed than them.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.16
notes.notes:
Hello, citizens!
We review all feedback daily and we hear you loud and clear!
We’re deploying an updated matchmaking system that will further optimize the player experience.

During this update:

 If you fail to extract in a raid a certain number of times in a row, you will jump into a match with players experiencing the same difficulties along with a lower-than-normal number of players for greater chances of survival.
 Once you’re back on your feet and get some victories, you will be jumping back into the normal queue.


This system aims to give players a better chance to recover after a few bad runs.
It’s just a small step leading towards the best matchmaking balance we can provide.
We will continue hearing your feedback and working on continuously improving the overall experience.

See you in Century City!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.12
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens!
We are here with the second update of the week.

This is an update that aims to significantly improve your experience with Hell is Others.
During these first few weeks since the release we constantly monitored the game balance and, also thanks to your feedback, we are now ready for the first round of weapon rebalancing changes.
Additionally, we are adding some quality-of-life features. 


We listened to the feedback from the content creators too.
We adjusted the current status effects for the twitch polls and implemented new debuffs.

You can find the detailed patch notes below!

Summary

 Weapon Balancing
 Replaced in Twitch Polls “Heal all Statuses” with a “Wheel of…Fortune” feature.
 Twitch polls debuffs are now instantly removed when the streamer kills another player.
 Twitch polls debuffs are no longer raid permanent and have a 30~60 second duration time.
 Removed Bleeding from Twitch polls – Save that blood for the Bonsai!
 Added new twitch polls debuffs. (You can find the list below)
 Improved character stats and character belongings UI
 Wallpapers are now sold in stacks of 10 each
 Owners of the Good Neighbor Pack will receive 10 additional wallpapers.
 From now on, new Good Neighbor Pack buyers will receive 20 wallpapers.
 Added new sound effects to the map

Changes
 Now, when using a syringe, only the first application of the effect over time can be heard by the Others.
 Added icon in furniture menus (basement and shop) indicating if an item can be used to sleep.
 Bullet requirements in the elimination quests are now shown only if the required weapon requires a specific bullet. (i.e., if any weapon can be used, including melee weapons and devices, the information regarding the bullet is omitted).
 New Debuffs for Twitch Polls – New Opportunities!


Fixes

 Fixed Police Station printer not having searching time.


Weapon Balancing

The biggest problem we had was a wide gap of damage output between wild bullets and modified bullets caused by the Rotation Speed Towards Target bonus that basically allowed to completely bypass the recoil of any weapon.
This resulted in players landing shots too consistently, making fights less skill-based and overly fast. To address this, we reduced the homing bullets' detection range so that it no longer interferes with the recoil and reduced the rotation speed cap too.
To further reduce the damage output difference, we also halved the critical chance cap and reduced the critical damage bonus to +25%.

Thanks to your feedback and our analytics, we then noticed a strong imbalance in weapon use, with ARs and fully automatic weapons in general being chosen over any other weapon type in most cases.
We proceeded therefore to slightly lower their offensive capabilities and improved those of the Shotguns, the least used weapon category in the game.

Another problem we felt needed to be addressed was Movement Speed. Players using pills and fungi were able to reach movement speeds so high it was too hard for others to escape when being chased.
To solve this, we reduced the movement speed cap to 20% and reduced the movement speed bonus from all weapons.


 Reduced homing bullets' detection range from 3 to 1.
 Reduced bullet rotation speed cap from 280 to 175.
 Reduced bullet critical chance cap from 50% to 25%.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.8
notes.notes:
Greetings Century City Citizens, 

 
We thank you for all the feedback given to us over the past few weeks, it allows us to further optimize the features of the game and enhance your experience during your stay. 

Please find below some of the changes that will be coming during this update. 

 
SUMMARY 


 Improving the New Player Experience.
We heard a lot of players are struggling against more experienced Others. We decided to reserve a queue for beginners to reduce the steepness of the learning curve for new players.
 Improved matchmaking 
 New apartment interactions! 
 Quality of Life Fixes! (Find the full list of fixes below) 


CHANGES 


 Implemented separated queues for beginners.
 Added small details to the game map. 
 Now when an NPC is locked, also the relative items are shut down as well. For instance, Conroy's TV or Lizzie's jukebox are shut down if they are not unlocked yet. 
 Improved tutorial hints. 
 Now lamps and neons in the hub can be switched on/off. 
 Prevented spawning Floaters and Hiders after the start of the match. 
 Added independent Music and Sound Effects volume settings.
 Added a new shooting animation for the Lady Marshall. 


FIXES 


 Fixed glitch happening in certain conditions when coming back to the penthouse after obtaining the quest "Pay Up". 
 Fixed left stick not working correctly when moving between doors in hub and when switching from inventory to other in-game panels. 
 Fixed player getting stuck in elevator after completing extraction if opening the bug report panel before match recap opens up. 
 Fixed cancelling a melee attack by dodging still rendering the melee animation. 
 Fixed bug allowing to trigger the weapon switch while performing a melee attack, reducing the required time for equipping the new weapon. 
 Fixed bug causing a wrong behavior when switching between a fire weapon and melee weapon while aiming. 
 Fixed sorting basement items by storage date not working.

notes.title: HELL IS OTHERS | Release date announcement
notes.notes:
HELL IS OTHERS WILL RELEASE ON OCTOBER 20, 2022 ON STEAM!

A List Games, a community first publisher and Strelka Games & Yonder, two Italian-based game studios, are glad to announce Hell is Others will launch on October 20, 2022 for $14.99 on Steam! 

Interested players can also sign up for the closed beta, which starts September 2nd at 5 pm CEST / 8 am PDT / 11 am EDT on the Hell is Others Steam page!

In Hell is Others, you play as Adam Smithson as he does his best to exist in his tiny apartment, alone, high above Century City. His only companion is a bonsai tree, which he dutifully cares for. But like everything else in the city, his plant requires blood to survive. So Adam is forced to find a regular supply on the dark streets below. Players descend into the city to explore for resources and accomplish missions while trying to survive the night.  

With the spoils of your trip down into the city, players can furnish their apartment with items that give them added perks or benefits while playing in multiplayer. Continue to water your bonsai tree and other houseplants with the blood of your enemies to grow custom ammunition. 

A hybrid of customization mechanics and extraction-style gameplay, all set in a surreal, noir world, Hell is Others is a David Lynch-vibes game that features pixel graphics and a deeply compelling story. It is a slice of life in a nightmare city.

notes.title: Dev Update #12: Play With Friends

The concept of friendship does not exist on the streets of Century City. Anything that moves threatens your business, possessions and life: do you want to be prey or predator?

notes.title: Dev update #11: Attributes and Imagos!
notes.notes:
Hey all!
Welcome to a new update from Century City!

Today we're going to talk about Attributes and Imagos! Two ways of improving your character! 
The first way is by eating pills and mushrooms, and the other one is by adding furniture and appliances to your apartment.

The main differences between the two are the type of improvement and their permanence.

The improvements given by the pills and mushrooms are temporary and reset when dying.

The improvements given by the Imagos are permanent as long as you keep the appliances and furniture in your house.

Now, let's dive in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/fb969e13fa3276ac9ee9796af64589bc7b6cc2c0.gif

Pills
Pills are the most refined product when we talk about enhancing your attributes. It's possible to buy pills in the shops or loot them in Century City.
There are many of them, and each improves a single skill.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/fe80ad43246bdeec39ad87f23cf87f1a148ea6a5.png

The attributes affected by pills are:

Vitality (aka max health)
Endurance (aka max stamina)
Sight
Olfaction
Movement speed


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/5b4c81cfab16edc9fa32f8941f5a461f8b243d97.gif

Eating pills provides no downside, as you can see in the picture below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/623390f0c4070b5a0fe916e89252bc09a7a2f844.png


Mushrooms
Mushrooms are easier to find than pills as it's possible to loot them from monsters' remains. 
As you may have realized, mushrooms are not safe to eat as pills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/4b90440e6e7be9a126b4a5646828ee4ea79387e3.png

They enhance the same attributes that pills do but decrease them as well. 
Double-checking before eating is a good idea but don't worry too much if you don't. You can always compensate for side effects by eating pills!

THE PICTURE SHOWN IS FOR ILLUSTRATION PURPOSES ONLY. THE ACTUAL PRODUCT MAY VARY DUE TO PRODUCT ENHANCEMENT. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/bde5f86d1f1c571d734805f250bac5721d2c3b27.png


Imagos
Helping the inhabitants of Century City with their tasks unlocks different shops in the City, a few of which sell furniture and appliances for your apartment. 

These items are not only capable of storing items and making your house a cozy place to live in, but they also provide Imagos.
Imagos are passive effects Adam receives from the furniture.
For example, an Imago can reduce the recoil of the shotgun by five.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/aff5c346639f362e14975c14e222ea7f8a98bca8.png


You can find a dedicated section with a list of all the Imagos in your journal!
As you can see, they are many, and they influence the reloading speed, the recoil of the guns, the healing efficiency, and a lot more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/1e1eaf8e98033f55937fded57841a0d35a24111d.png

That's all for today, folks!
Thanks for your time✨

The Hider lives inside the walls of Century City, and it's invisible to human eyes. You have to pay attention to the walls, ending in its range means getting beat by its enormous teeth.

notes.title: Dev Update #8: Adam's apartment!
notes.notes:
Hey, fam!
It's been a while since the last update, but hey, now I'm back!

In this dev update, I'm going to talk about a new feature of the game, the one that will make every interior designer happy!
The customization of Adam's apartment :)

This is the hub you used to know, complete with a lot of stuff, a proper kitchen, a living room, etc.  👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/ca70f4eb2354517388dd4fe046e161ba36fe3352.gif

But this is just a placeholder, furnished to our taste!
Surprised? Well, the best part is yet to come 👀

The apartment you'll start from will be looking more like the one below.
I kind of like it. It does remind me of my first apartment as a college student: old, creepy, and cold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/10e7541d20964a8ffc020462c333185cf8ae63b7.png

So, does it mean that you'll have to live in my college apartment forever? NO!
Why? Because the HUB is fully customizable!
You can furnish your apartment with different pieces of furniture and appliances, but you can also build new rooms and floors!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/3861dd1eefead63d83746f604be66f2a6e3a62ea.gif

But how does it works? 
In Century City, there are plenty of shops, and a couple of them sell furniture and appliances for your home. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/fdb9db577eac316dcda46dc72f5fe8453d7b41b3.gif
(The shops UI is WIP)

From these shops, you can buy a lot of new furniture and appliances for your apartment, like sofas, lights, wardrobes, sinks, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/37de05f23f6d772c9c4887ebfc3cf73b582099de.png


Once you buy a piece of furniture, you'll not get it immediately in your inventory. So if you die, you'll not lose what you just bought, don't worry!

notes.title: Dev update 6 - A practical guide to bullet farming.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, it’s finally time to have a chat about the farming system!

As you might know, in Hell is Others bullets are organic elements that grow in nature. 
They can be shot, and they can also be planted. If watered and adequately taken care of, they will grow into beautiful bullet plants that will give back new bullets. In addition to this, you can create your own unique blends of bullets by mixing different fertilizers while growing your plants.

Let’s deep dive into the system!

Our farming is based on three elements:

bullets
vases
fertilizers


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/0e52307bef4858d41e30b34c604a50281ffb7941.gif


Bullets
You will be able to plant baseline bullets, those bullets that have not already been modified. They are called Bullet Vulgaris, and they come in different calibers. The main differences between calibers are damage and weapon compatibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/c1c3444fb8309131ef60c3218548bb2bbf67e001.gif

Vases
To grow your bullet plants at home, you will need to buy vases at the pottery down in Century City. They have different characteristics:

Efficiency. The amount of blood needed for the plant in the vase to grow to the next phase. The higher the Efficiency, the less the amount of blood required, making the farming more cost-effective.

Fertility. The number of fertilizers the vase can contain. Each fertilizer occupies a different amount of Mutation units and the Fertility parameter indicates the total Mutation units available in a vase. For example, a vase with a Fertility of 10 allows for ten 1-point fertilizers or two 5-point fertilizers, or a combination of those.

Productivity. It determines the number of bullets produced by the plant once fully grown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/ed38080fad2e9d7df077ccccbf14ca7aca9e38ff.png

Fertilizers
Fertilizers are the remains of the Things that roam the streets of Century City and, applied to bullet plants, can modify the characteristics of the produced bullets. All of them can be extracted from dead Things but the most powerful and refined ones are only available from the Flower Shop.
Some of the parameters modified by the fertilizers are damage dealt, bullet range, damage area (explosions), bounciness, fragmentation, velocity, and loudness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/f3adf604e79232aba53968e97cc2e7a8be86662b.png

That’s it for this update! 
Let us know what you think and don’t forget to join us on Discord!

notes.title: Dev Update #5 - Let’s talk about some lore
notes.notes:
Philosophy
Hell is Others is inspired by a Jean-Paul Sartre quote: "hell is other people". For the french author, merely looking at each other is a violent act that every person inflicts on another. He states that hell is on earth because a person feels violated by other people. 

Starting from this point of view, the game's most frightening, dangerous, and devious enemies are the other players (the Others).
But at the same time, HIO is a critique of the philosopher's thought. In other people's gaze, the subject is projecting their fears and their vision about the world. 

Maybe, as stated by another philosopher, Levi-Strauss, hell is not outside but inside every person. And that's the reason why in the game, every Other is, in fact, Adam Smithson, the protagonist.
Every day, Adam wakes up knowing that he will be fighting against the Others and, at the same time, against himself.
He is obsessed with thriving and finding the truth, which inevitably translates to a constant need for blood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/edcd80a583043c92c34a1b09e3ccb3745d5792fd.gif


Narrative Background
The world of HIO is suspended in time and space. It is made of the same matter that nightmares are made of, and it confines its inhabitants in an endless sleep.

Everything is ruled by cyclicality and repetition. Everything seems to be made to confuse and disorient, and everyone seems to be stuck in an open-eye unconscious state, kind of a dream.

At the beginning of the story, Adam wakes up in that dream, and like everyone who is sleeping and dreaming, he doesn't realize it. Everything he sees and does feel normal to him. Even if it's surreal and monstrous, it is their daily routine. In this miserable place, bullets grow in nature, and the primary resource is blood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/7834bf2b43cb59fba1a2cd57cc71c8ed93077a5c.gif


Century City
Century City is the city in which the events of HIO are set. Century it's not only a place. It is also a point in time. To be more precise, it's not even a place or a moment in time. It's a mix of every time and places of the 20th century. It looks like the 50s in the 80s, but there are elements from all the last century's decades. Yet, Century City is frozen in an endless night.

At the beginning of the story, the city is desolate, and its inhabitants seem hostile and unfriendly. But as time goes by — and thanks to Adam taking blood from the creatures in the city and giving it back to the city economy — Century will prosper and gain a macabre glory.

notes.title: Dev Update #4 - Blood&Money
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another update about Hell is Others!
We are working tirelessly on the game and if you want to keep up with the daily updates, make sure to follow us on Twitter!

Today I'm going to talk about the game's economy, but I need to briefly recap what HIO is about before moving on to that topic.
It should be clear by now that the game is based on the balance between staying home and raiding the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/2c6cd85765c4f8daad334b7952c32de6cbeb020d.jpg

At home, you can organize your stash, take care of your plants, let the days pass, and even modify the house itself.

https://media.giphy.com/media/9MZL8bwB4084ScagDH/giphy.gif

During your raids instead, you will need to fight to gather the resources you need to survive and thrive, so you will not only have to loot, but you will also have to trade with merchants.


Now, how can you buy the stuff you need? Why have we always referred to blood as the central resource of the game?
First, to buy consumables, weapons, furniture and every other item in the game, you will need money. Good old dirty money.
There are a few ways to get cash, ordered from the less profitable to the most:

 you can find it as loot around Century City
 you can sell items at the shops
 you can sell blood at the bank


https://media.giphy.com/media/dHzqDSgDIRAJhQgQ7z/giphy.gif  https://media.giphy.com/media/QlYNM38t7vj6jqIIXf/giphy.gif

This brings us to blood and its importance.
Once you kill Things or Others, you will be able to collect all they were carrying around with them, including their hearts. Those are rich in blood and can be traded for money in any bank, but be careful because that's not the only use there is for blood.
You will need blood to be able to:

 water your plants. Without blood, there's no way you will be able to grow your plants and produce bullets for your weapons.
 water your bonsai. To keep it alive, you will need to water it every day and you won’t be able to go to sleep, letting the current day pass, until you’ve done so (more to come on this topic).


https://media.giphy.com/media/d2CtCv72KSu3uI6P9l/giphy.gif

So yes, money is important, but blood is vital!

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Taking To The Streets (multiplayer explanation)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone and welcome back to a new dev update!

Last time we talked about bullets and how they can be planted and farmed.
As you might remember, blood is required for them to grow, and leaving the safety of your home to venture into Century City is the only way to acquire such a precious resource.

Taking To The Streets
Armed with courage and some of the weapons, bullets, and items obtained during the previous expeditions, you reach for the button to call the lift that will take you to the streets.
Only a brief wait separates you from the action, just enough for the matchmaker to find other players to join the hunt.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/df05aa3ef47aa2a10fcb1323ac94d069ee4163e3.gif

As the doors of the lift opens, you find yourself in one of the alleys, disoriented, unaware of your exact location in the city. You don’t know how many Others you will encounter either, you only know that, within the depths of this ever-changing city, scarce resources lie around, Things roam every corner looking for fresh blood and bizarre merchants try to make profits out of an economy based on slaughter.

You start exploring your surroundings, trying to familiarise yourself with the place you were taken to. You know you need to be able to get back to your lift once the time’s up or you’d die a terrible death, so you pay attention to every possible cue in order to be able to retrace your steps.

Dying would mean losing everything you have taken with you when you left your home, leaving all of that on the ground for Others to plunder. It would also mean losing all the physical and mental improvements achieved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/c1120598b7f056f374f5ea6a812ee3f03889396b.gif

Fortunately, though, death is not the end.
Your Adam will be respawned, and you will choose to either get back into the fight or retreat home. Should the first option be your pick, you will find yourself near a lift and the operator will be there for you. If you had left him items, you could retrieve them from his custody. Otherwise, he will always have some bullets for you. They are not as fresh as the ones you grow at home or find on plants though. They are rotten, less effective, but still useful to get back on your feet.

Will you try to get back what you lost, or will you play it safe? Will you hunt your killer, or get on and pursue different objectives? Will you be predator or prey?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/964440/Hell_is_Others/

notes.title: Dev Update #2 - Bullets&Farming
notes.notes:
Hey wonderful people of the internet, I'm back!

After explaining the senses through which Adam perceives the world around him, this week I'd like to continue with another key part of the gameplay: the stuff you shoot, AKA the bullets.

The first choice we made was to direct our focus more towards bullets rather than weapons. Don't worry, there will be plenty of those too and we will talk about them in the next updates, but the bullets we have created have a major impact on gunplay and are really different from anything you might be used to. 

Let's get straight to the point: in Hell is Others, bullets are organic.
They are like legumes, both fruit and seed, and can be found growing everywhere in Century City.
This means that, when walking the streets and through the parks, you can find plants ripe with bullets for the taking. It also means that you will need to treat and store them properly, otherwise they rot and become less effective.

https://media.giphy.com/media/RJ39StmDLq0ZMc8qBP/giphy.gif

There are many different kinds of bullets that you can find and shoot. I'm going to show you my current top 3 favourites:

Bouncing bullets can be super effective in closed spaces! 👇
https://media.giphy.com/media/ksLWQDm3rw29uHtEgm/giphy.gif

Exploding bullets are indicated for crowded situations 👇
https://media.giphy.com/media/MoOV9ovnA8Mxo19iJF/giphy.gif

Fragmentable bullets are great at close range 👇
https://media.giphy.com/media/taWnkMDX2QAzSqHDlA/giphy.gif

Now, I see what you are thinking: if they grow in nature, if they are like legumes, and if you can harvest them from a plant, does it mean you can farm them?
YES, YOU CAN!

You can plant, farm and harvest bullets at home.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/442c6fce2a000e03f65678cbfa553f14e3416d39.png

First of all, you will need a vase. Then a bullet.
Once you plant your favourite type of bullet, you need to water it.
How? You may ask. Well, with some blood, of course! The same blood that you will gather by killing other players or creatures. The same blood you could exchange for money.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/4d51ab4e3b558dff27c46598a16c2181ea41a6d1.png

By watering bullet plants day in and day out, you will make them grow, mature and bear fruits.
Once mature, you will be able to harvest the plants and collect new bullets from them. But be careful, not taking care of your plants will result in them withering and then dying!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/27682e5cce47b92a0f88e7cd9c96a91403700774.gif

You will also be able to add different kinds of fertilisers to enhance both the plants and their fruits. You can increase the yield of a plant or improve the characteristics of the bullets produced, like their loudness, their range or their damage.

Hopefully, I've managed to give you a good idea about how bullets and farming work in Hell is Others. See you next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/964440/Hell_is_Others/?

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I'm Pietro and, among a few other things, I'm the one who takes care of the production of HIO. Together with the fantastic people in the team, I will try to explain week by week what Hell is Others is while showing you part of our day by day work.

So, here we are: first week, first update! I want to start from the foundation of the game: the gameplay.

As you might know, Hell is Others is a mix of different genres and it has life-simulation, farming, roguelike and RPG elements. Still, at its core, it is a top-down multiplayer survival shooter.

In the next few weeks, I will better explain the multiplayer dynamics but basically, when leaving your home to venture into Century City, you might find yourself into PVP and PVE fights. They might be the main reason to go but you could also have other interests and prefer avoiding everyone else entirely.

With that being said, let's have a closer look at how the sensory system works.

The player has three senses:


 sight
 hearing
 olfaction


Sight
How could we simulate the sight of a character in a 2D top-down game?
We decided to implement a sight cone. Certain things are always visible to you, like buildings, inanimate objects and NPCs for example. Other things are only visible when they are inside your sight cone, like enemies, bullet plants or blood.
This recreates the experience of a 3D environment, making the fighting and exploration phases more exciting and tactical.

https://media.giphy.com/media/4Qphmt76Cy8k8XAhgX/giphy.gif
https://media.giphy.com/media/t4P5myBK7XuTx3msxq/giphy.gif

Hearing
Another big challenge for the team is to find the right way to implement the audio system.
In Hell is Others, being able to locate sounds is a key factor for survival. Imagine hearing someone walking in a puddle near you, someone shooting behind a corner, or a monstrous creature screaming in a room and not being able to determine the distance or the direction of that sound. Whether you want to fight or run away, you need to be able to have spatial information about the sounds you hear.

So, how did we do it?
First of all, we implemented the sounds in the standard way, so that you can hear if they are coming from the left or the right side of the screen (keep in mind that the player is always centred). The volume of the sound is determined by the distance between the emitter and your character. Well, that's pretty standard you might think, and in fact it is. But how can you determine if a sound is coming from north or south of the character? 
We added visual feedback so that you can easily recognize the direction from which the sound is coming from and its intensity.

[previewyoutube=RdycTSUxlf4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Olfaction
Please bear with me here, because this is something a little bit different compared to what we typically see in videogames.
Blood is a crucial resource in Hell is Others and it can be collected in different ways: you can loot it from dead players or bots, or you can even buy it. The total amount of blood that you are carrying is determined by your character's level and the blood you have in your inventory.
What’s essential in this context though, is that you can smell other players' blood. If you are close to a player whose amount of blood is higher than yours, you will have both audio and visual feedback.
As for audio, you will hear a heartbeat: the closer the player is to you, the faster the heartbeat goes. But what if there is more than one player close to you? The heartbeat will multiply in an almost musical rhythm. Easier to listen to than to explain!
Visually, you will see a pulsating vignette on screen, synced with the sounds.

[previewyoutube=ODGIqryVApU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Oh, and one last thing: all the senses can be boosted! 

That's it, people! See you next week, in the meanwhile feel free to ask anything in the comments below or join us on our Discord server!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39298344/8e8810089dd969844ea197283189eaec70f572f7.png
